description: Measures Δ¹g — the bare first-order per-bond amplitude declared the surviving open magnitude object by docs/audits/2026-08-02-mu3-submodularity-vacuous-at-deuteron.md (bean qou-i4pz) — directly at the deuteron (A=2, H₆, convention D). Two contributions. (1) Δ¹g IS measurable: the audit's 'no numerical probe is run' is correct for Δ²g (an A=2 second interface would have to be fabricated) but does not apply to Δ¹g, a single-bond object; and the corpus already contained the measurement in gap10_tjon_correlation_probe.py (merged #4406) as M_op(2), uncited by the successor work. (2) The identification `Δ¹g = the fitted C_knot = 5.853` is dimensionally UNBRIDGED: C_knot = B_AME/B_cat is a fitted ratio of MeV binding energies under the SIGNED master functional B_cat = m_e·|Σ_λ y_λ χ^λ·sgn f^λ|, whereas Δ¹g is an additive difference in the UNSIGNED functional g = Σ_λ y_λ|χ_λ|. Different functionals, different dimensions; under the obvious multiplicative reading the measured magnitude falls short. Precedent for treating this as a real hazard rather than a quibble: a3_units_consistency_probe.py found precisely this MeV-vs-dimensionless pun on precisely this C_knot, and repairing it swung the reported gap from a 1.66× overshoot to a 3.53× undershoot across the full unpinned factor. SCOPE-(a) on the IDENTIFICATION only: this does NOT refute Δ¹g as the open object and does NOT disturb the μ₃-vacuity result, which rests on the independent proved identity Δ²g ≡ 0 on single-bond configs. Convention D throughout (owner ruling 2026-08-09). No Δ_λ, no C_knot fitted, nothing wired. VERDICT: Δ¹g measured at the deuteron (convention D, H₆) = -0.556544660; it is a single-bond object so no fabricated interface is needed and the audit's 'no numerical probe' — correct for Δ²g — does not apply. The corpus already contained this measurement in gap10_tjon_correlation_probe (merged #4406, uncited by the successor work). The `Δ¹g = C_knot = 5.854` identification is NOT bridged: C_knot is a fitted ratio of MeV from the SIGNED functional m_e·|Σ y_λ χ^λ sgn f^λ|, while Δ¹g is an additive difference in the UNSIGNED functional Σ y_λ|χ_λ|; under the obvious multiplicative reading the measured |Δ¹g| falls short by 10.5×. Precedent: a3_units_consistency_probe found this exact MeV-vs-dimensionless pun on this exact C_knot, swinging 1.66× overshoot to 3.53× undershoot. Scope-(a) on the IDENTIFICATION only — Δ¹g remains the open object and the μ₃ vacuity result is untouched.
